rules: 1D C2 (18:00 NY roll, method_spec 3.2, one-sided); most recent 1h CISD (series_open, 2/2, max_wait 3) in the C2 direction confirmed inside C2, protected swing intact at the C2 close and beyond it
stop below both C2 EQ and 50% of the CISD series: min(EQ, CISD50) long, max short; must be on the stop side of the C2 close
take only if (max(C1 high, C2 high) - C2 close) >= 2 x (C2 close - stop) (mirror short)
decide at the C2 close, enter at the first M1 open of C3 (positional), 2R target, 1380 trading min; control on the 1D close grid
